quote: While investigating the (now-resolved) inconsistency in sizes between meas_modelfit and MultiProFit (DM-21124), I decided to look into whether they result from differences and/or bugs in the implementations of approximate Sersic profiles in both packages.
As a further result of running the script in #1, I made some relatively low-effort optimizations in DM-21124 and DM-21220.
DM-20493 re-made plots including flux-size relations for COSMOS/HST galaxies.
As a further result of running the script in #1, I made some relatively low-effort optimizations in DM-21124 and DM-21220.
DM-21071 found that MultiProFit is 1-2 orders of magnitude slower than meas_modelfit at fitting the same models (e.g. just exp/dev).
DM-21380 added model photometry metrics to verify_metrics, which are used in validate_drp.
I added a few more inline comments, tagged some kwargs as optional, and filed DM-21197 to cover one of the to-dos.

DM-21887 determined that it would be possible but not particularly easy to determine the PSF by fitting stars, so this ticket will implement fitting the TinyTim-based model PSF for the nearest source in the GalSim catalog as an interim solution.
DM-21801 and DM-21802 added Gaussian fit and HST-COSMOS imaging options to MultiProFitTask.
After adding a non-PSF convolved Gaussian fit option in DM-21801, I found an additional bug with the mapping of where Jacobian outputs are stored and fixed that.
